briefings.title: The rise of industrial policy - why governments are back in the business of business

people.name: Erik Peterson
people.role: Managing Director, Global Business Policy Council, Kearney

people.name: Lizhi Liu
people.role: Assistant Professor, McDonough School of Business, Georgetown University

briefings.tldr: Industrial policy has returned as a central tool of geostrategy, shifting the global economic focus from market-driven efficiency to national security, self-reliance, and the control of strategic "choke points."
